model.first layer: film elements with a tooth element among the six neighbours
model.tooth: rigid: u = 0 on every node of a tooth element (checked against the elastic tooth on the full box)
model.crop: bounding box of field cells with phi > 0.01 (not tooth) + 1.0 mm margin, free faces
model.layer: film within 0.1 mm of the tooth surface (signed distance at the element centre)

flat film.note: von Mises = E (alpha - 1) / (1 - nu), p = 2/3 of it, per field cell; flat film on a rigid wall

full_elastic_voxel_m4.label: full box, elastic tooth, voxel tooth, block means (= real_tooth_convergence 48^3)

full_rigid_voxel_m4.label: full box, rigid tooth, voxel tooth

full_rigid_sdf_m4.label: full box, rigid tooth, sdf tooth

crop1_rigid_sdf_m4.label: crop 1 mm, rigid, sdf tooth, void kept

crop2_rigid_sdf_m4.label: crop 2 mm, rigid, sdf tooth, void kept

crop1_drop_m4.label: crop 1 mm, rigid, sdf tooth, void dropped (phi <= 0.01)

crop1_rigid_sdf_m2.label: crop 1 mm, rigid, sdf tooth, void kept, h = 2 h_f

crop2_rigid_sdf_m2.label: crop 2 mm, rigid, sdf tooth, void kept, h = 2 h_f

crop1_drop_m2.label: crop 1 mm, rigid, void dropped (phi <= 0.01), h = 2 h_f

crop1_drop05_m2.label: crop 1 mm, rigid, void dropped (phi <= 0.05), h = 2 h_f

crop1_voxel_m2.label: crop 1 mm, rigid, voxel tooth, void kept, h = 2 h_f

crop1_drop_r1_pc.label: crop 1 mm, rigid, sdf tooth, void dropped, h = h_f, piecewise constant

field96_r2_pc.label: 96^3 field, crop 1 mm, rigid, sdf tooth, void dropped (phi <= 0.01), h = h_f/2 = 0.083, piecewise constant

crop1_r2_tri.label: 192^3 field, crop 1 mm, rigid, voxel wall, void dropped (phi <= 0.05), h = h_f/2 = 0.042, trilinear (level r2 is piecewise constant)

subbox.region: field cells with |y| < 0.7 mm (the middle of the flank)
